title: AI co-scientist independently reproduces an unpublished superbug finding in ~48 hours
summary: Google's multi-agent co-scientist, built on Gemini 2.0, generated and ranked research hypotheses; for Imperial College researchers it proposed the same mechanism for antimicrobial resistance spread that their unpublished work had found.
agent_role: Agents generated, debated and ranked hypotheses from a research goal; scientists set the goal and validated selected hypotheses in wet-lab experiments.
outcome: Reached the Imperial team's unpublished hypothesis in about 48 hours and proposed further hypotheses, one new to the researchers; Google also reports end-to-end lab validation in drug repurposing and treatment-target work

curation.rationale: Launch seed collection, researched from search results.
